messages:
Sam: Heads-up: starting migration for orders.schema.v2 in 10m. Want to clarify deploybot retry policy and rollback thresholds.
Priya: Are we keeping the pin to engine v1.8.2-quant for the canary?
Sam: Yes — pin canary to v1.8.2-quant. Fallback chain -> v1.7.9 if we see OOMs.
deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled canary rollout for orders_schema_v2 on shard-3. Job ID: dbmig-20260321-1785234567
Marco: Quick question — what's the retry behavior for lock timeouts? We had transient 30s locks earlier.
Priya: Proposal: retry up to 3 attempts with exponential backoff (15s, 30s, 60s). If cumulative lock wait >3m, pause the rollout and notify.
Kate: If the rollout pauses who is responsible to unschedule the job? Ops or the release owner?
Sam: Release owner triages first. Ops can /deploybot abort dbmig-20260321-1785234567 if we need an immediate rollback. Auto-rollback heuristic: if lock_age > 5m across >1 node -> automatic rollback.
deploybot: deploybot: Policy update applied: retries=3 backoff=[15s,30s,60s]. Auto-rollback triggers: lock_age>300s OR apply_error_rate>2% sustained across 2 consecutive batches. Alerts sent to #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Quiesce window enforced: 10m pre-deploy, 5m post-apply. On pause/rollback -> page #incidents and runbook owner.
Priya: I'll update the runbook and attach the SQL snippet for the safe-apply below.
Priya: ```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN order_status_int integer DEFAULT 0;
UPDATE orders SET order_status_int = CASE WHEN status = 'NEW' THEN 0 WHEN status='FULFILLED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
-- backfill batched by id asc, 500 rows per txn
COMMIT;
```
Sam: Release note draft: "Orders schema v2 (enum->int). Canary pinned to engine v1.8.2-quant on shard-3. Retry policy 3x with exponential backoff. Rollback triggers for sustained locks and elevated apply error rates." :eyes:
Marco: :thumbsup: Sounds good. I'll watch the canary and report any anomalies.
deploybot: deploybot: Canary started at 1785234567. Monitoring hooks enabled (latency, lock_age, apply_error_rate). Will post status updates here.
